message.content: The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 383 miles (≈616 km) via I‑5 S. Under normal conditions it takes about 6 hours, but during peak traffic or on weekends it can stretch to 7–8 hours. If you’re planning a trip, it’s a good idea to check real‑time traffic updates and consider leaving early in the morning or late at night to avoid rush hour congestion.
